name: Uroko
source:
"Because I heard a voice. I opened my eyes and it was you."

You picked up a mysterious man on the beach at night.
Living together in a mysterious way can make a difference in your mind.
"I want to know more."—
You wonder if that desire is actually right.

[NovelGame page MTL]
translation:
“因为我听到了一个声音。我睁开眼睛，是你。”

晚上你在海滩上遇见了一个神秘的男人。
以一种神秘的方式生活在一起可以改变你的想法。
“我想了解更多。”——
你想知道这个愿望是否真的正确。

[小说游戏页面]
